periods.time: vol-10 ch-004 ending to ch-005, after the semifinals

name.zh: 雾子救回被死亡结果侵蚀的一辉
name.en: Kiriko saves Ikki from the lingering death result

periods.location: Wangan Dome preparation room and medical facility
periods.summary: Shizuku rushes to congratulate Ikki after his win and finds him standing unconscious in the preparation room without breathing. Doctors restart his heart, but his body keeps shifting from one fatal crisis to another as if dragged toward death. Kurono's review shows that a death hand grazed Ikki's upper arm when he protected the referee. Shizuku panics and Itsuki suggests possible solutions, but Kurono cannot safely reverse Ikki's time by several minutes. Kiriko Yakushi arrives after being contacted, declares that a doctor must be able to defeat one or two death gods, and succeeds in saving Ikki where ordinary resuscitation fails.
periods.cause: During Amane's post-match rampage, Ikki was lightly touched by a concentrated death-result hand while saving the referee.
periods.outcome: Ikki survives, Kiriko repays Amane for causing her first-round withdrawal, and Ikki remains asleep until the following night.
casualties: ikki-kurogane nearly dies and misses the scheduled final day
periods.significance: Explains the delayed final and gives Kiriko a decisive in-world payoff after Amane's earlier manipulation of her first-round match.
